description:
One-click accept of a **held** decision (accountant) — posts the AI's proposal.

A person's accept in the app replaces the soft guardrails (confidence, amount cap,
risk flags). An agent's (MCP, API key, chat) is refused (403) unless the row is
``agent_acceptable``. Closed period, sealed year, unknown account: 409/422. The row
flips ``held → posted`` (a second accept is a 409), with ``accepted_by_kind`` the
kind of actor (``mcp`` over MCP).

The optional ``body``, omitted otherwise: ``expense:receipt:item:`` needs
``employee_id`` + ``category_id``; ``autopost:capitalize:`` needs
``fixed_asset_category_id`` when the hold has none, and ``needs_split_source`` a
``reclassify_from_account_code``.

anyOf.description: Optional ``POST /autopost-decisions/{id}/accept`` body; omit it for other kinds.

name: accept_autopost_decision
